intake.processDescription: A sandbox billing provider sends a documented signed event whenever a payment changes state. Validate the event and place a failed payment in a staff review queue; never retry the charge automatically.

sources.content: For signed provider events, verify the signature and stable event ID before processing.
Scheduled polling is suitable when a provider has no event delivery.

intake.processDescription: The HR sandbox confirms it emits a webhook for employee status changes. Update a local access-review queue with the event and require a reviewer before any account is disabled.

sources.content: Limit integration credentials to the minimum required scopes and fields.
Validate signed events and deduplicate by the provider event identifier.

intake.processDescription: A confirmed document API emits a signed file-ready callback after a report is generated. Store metadata in a sandbox table and create a review item without copying the document contents.
goals: Track ready reports with minimal data

sources.content: Check event signatures, replay identifiers, and required fields before accepting a callback.
Store only the fields necessary for the stated process; avoid copying source content by default.

intake.processDescription: New messages arriving in a dedicated vendor mailbox should be classified by document type and routed to a draft review record. A person decides whether anything is accepted.

sources.content: Start mailbox processing on a new-message event and preserve a stable message ID for deduplication.
A named person must make the acceptance decision; automation can prepare a draft only.

intake.processDescription: Each new message sent to the synthetic feedback inbox should be tagged by topic and added to an internal triage queue; no reply should be generated or sent.
goals: Make incoming feedback easier to triage

sources.content: A new email is an event trigger; deduplicate on the provider's immutable message ID.
Do not send generated messages without explicit human review and approval.

intake.processDescription: When the test finance mailbox receives a CSV attachment, check required columns and create a validation summary for an accountant. Keep the original attachment unchanged.

sources.content: Use a new-message event to start processing mailbox attachments.
Validate file type and size, preserve the original, and write derived results separately.

intake.processDescription: Every weekday at 06:30 Europe/Berlin, compare the synthetic SaaS license export with an approved user list and report mismatches. Do not change licenses automatically.

sources.content: Recurring reconciliations should state timezone, missed-run policy, and read-only behavior.
A user-click trigger is appropriate for one-off operator initiated work.

intake.processDescription: At 18:00 every Friday in Europe/Berlin, summarize synthetic warehouse stock changes from the week into a report for an operations lead.

sources.content: Use an explicit timezone for recurring scheduled work and define how missed runs are handled.
Use an event trigger only when the source reliably emits the event being monitored.

intake.processDescription: Once each night, inspect a synthetic table of service certificates and prepare a report for certificates expiring in the next 30 days.
goals: Provide advance warning of certificate expiry

sources.content: A recurring scan uses a schedule and should define timezone and missed-run behavior.
A human reviewer should approve externally visible changes.

intake.processDescription: A sales operator selects a synthetic opportunity and clicks Prepare Quote Review. The workflow should gather approved fields and create a draft checklist, not generate or send a quote.

sources.content: A direct operator action is a manual trigger and should not be confused with approval.
External commercial documents require a named reviewer before release.

intake.processDescription: An analyst chooses a date range in an internal form and presses Run Preview to compare two synthetic exports. The result is a preview and the source data must remain unchanged.

sources.content: An explicit user action starts a manual, on-demand workflow.
A dry run should not mutate either source and should identify its output as a preview.

intake.processDescription: A reviewer opens a synthetic campaign record and clicks Check Before Launch. The system should create a checklist of missing approvals and stop; it must not publish the campaign.

sources.content: A user-initiated action can start a bounded review workflow.
Publishing requires explicit authorization from a named human reviewer.

intake.processDescription: The team wants order details to appear in its demo system, but has not confirmed which order platform is authoritative or what event should begin processing.

sources.content: Confirm the source of truth, trigger, required fields, and data owner before designing an integration.
Validate signed webhooks after a provider event source has been confirmed.

intake.processDescription: A synthetic onboarding process should sync records between two named products, but API access, authentication, direction of sync, and conflict ownership have not been checked.

sources.content: Before specifying a sync, confirm API availability, scopes, direction, source of truth, and conflict handling.
Periodic checks are appropriate when a polling interval has been chosen.

intake.processDescription: The request says to process each new support ticket immediately but also says to run the job only at the end of each month. The process owner has not resolved the conflict.

sources.content: Resolve conflicting trigger or timing requirements with the process owner before implementation.
Calendar-based work needs a confirmed schedule and timezone.
